title: First-order root calculation for finite Galois field components
statement: Let B be a DVR domain with irreducible uniformizer pi and fraction field K. Let n>0 be a unit in B. Let E_i be finitely many finite Galois extensions of K with degrees dividing n [def-weil-field, def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Let p:X->Spec K be isomorphic over Spec K to the coproduct of Spec E_i. Set A=B[t]/(t^n-pi), q:Spec A->Spec B, j:Spec K->Spec B and a=pullback.snd(p followed by j,q). Assume a is quasi-compact and quasi-separated so its concrete relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] exists. For every normalization point x over the prime (t), let C be its actual stalk, m its maximal ideal, and tau the structural image of the root germ. Then m is contained in (tau)+m*m. Finiteness of normalization is not assumed. This asserts cotangent spanning only, not maximal ideal generation or residue separability.

source.place: Tags 09EV (uniformizer root), 09EB (Galois degree formula), 0BRM (Abhyankar), 09E7 (weakly unramified criterion), 0307 (localization)

proof.text: Obtain principalness of the normalization stalk maximal ideal, using only positivity of n and finite Galois field factors; drop the tame unit and degree-bound assumptions for this step.
Use the tame ramification calculation to obtain nonmembership of the structural root germ in the maximal-ideal square.
Apply the proved principal local-algebra criterion: the maximal ideal is contained in the root span. Compose with the inclusion of that span into its supremum with the maximal-ideal square.

theorem dvr_galois_components_root_cotangent
    (B : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (hn : IsUnit (n : B))
    (r : ℕ) (E : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, Field (E i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra (FractionRing B) (E i)]
    (hE : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) (E i) ∧
      IsGalois (FractionRing B) (E i) ∧ Module.finrank (FractionRing B) (E i) ∣ n)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)))
    (e : X ≅ ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (E i)))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (FractionRing B) (E i)))) = p) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A))
    let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
    let a := pullback.snd (p ≫ j) q
    ∀ (hqc : QuasiCompact a) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a),
    letI := hqc
    letI := hqs
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)} →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      let tau := (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom
        (StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x)
          (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)))
      let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C
      m ≤ Ideal.span {tau} ⊔ m * m
